metadata.title: Aleksandar Rijić · Full-stack developer
metadata.description: Full-stack developer, mostly frontend. Websites and apps in React and Next.js.

hero.availability: Open to freelance and full-time work
hero.heading: Aleksandar
hero.intro: Full-stack developer, mostly frontend. I build websites and apps in React and Next.js, and I handle the backend and deployment myself.

services.heading: Websites, web apps and mobile apps.
services.intro: Whatever the project, I care most about speed and about leaving code that someone else can take over.

items.title: Websites
items.blurb: Marketing sites and landing pages that work well on a phone. You edit the content yourself in a CMS, no need to call me.

items.title: Web apps
items.blurb: Dashboards, portals and internal tools, including the boring but important parts like login, permissions and forms.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.blurb: iOS and Android apps in React Native, published to the App Store and Google Play.

paragraphs: I've been doing this for four years, mostly React and Next.js on the frontend, with Node and Postgres on the backend. Frontend is still the part I enjoy most.

I pay attention to details, like how fast a page loads and what a form says when something goes wrong. I use AI tools every day for boilerplate and tests, which leaves me more time for architecture. If something in the brief isn't clear, I ask before I start.
about.callout: Right now I'm open to both a full-time role and freelance projects.

steps.title: Kickoff
steps.blurb: We talk, then I write a short summary of what we agreed. Before I write any code I want to know who it's for and what you want out of it.

steps.title: Design
steps.blurb: Wireframes first, then the real screens. You see them early, while things are still easy to change.

steps.title: Build
steps.blurb: I work in small steps and you can follow along on a preview link.

steps.title: Launch
steps.blurb: Deploy, analytics, docs and a short walkthrough. A few weeks after launch we check in to see if anything needs changing.

projects.intro: A few things I've built recently.

items.title: Plava Laguna Partners Portal
items.blurb: A portal for Plava Laguna's travel agency partners, behind a login. Properties, fact sheets and photos are in one place, with filters for type, stars and location. Content lives in Contentful, so the team updates it without a developer.

items.title: Celeste
items.blurb: An app for learning astronomy. Spaced-repetition flashcards, constellation quizzes and an AR view: point the camera at the sky and it shows which planets and meteor showers are up tonight. There are also levels, XP and daily streaks.

items.title: Focus Flow
items.blurb: A task manager with Today, Board and Categories screens, a Kanban board from todo to done, and due-date reminders. Login and data run on Supabase, and each user only sees their own tasks.

items.title: Posavski Med
items.blurb: A website for a family beekeeping business from Posavina: their products, the family's story and a blog. The goal was to get visitors to reach out. Fully static, no backend.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A simple website usually takes two to three weeks. For an app it depends on scope, so you'll get an estimate after our first call. If it looks like we'll run over, I'll tell you right away.
Fixed price when the scope is clear, a weekly rate when it isn't yet. You know the price before I start.

items.q: Do you work with existing teams?
items.a: Yes. I can join an existing codebase, follow your conventions and review PRs. The first week I ask a lot of questions.

items.q: What if I only need part of a project?
items.a: Sure. For example a frontend for an API you already have, building from a Figma design, or fixing speed and accessibility on a site that's already live.

items.q: Do you keep working on it after launch?
items.a: If you want. You get docs so you don't depend on me, and I can stay on for fixes and small features on a monthly basis.

contact.heading: Have a project or a job offer? Get in touch.
contact.intro: Hiring, freelance or just a technical question, send it over. I reply to every message.
